description: Checks stated buyer requirements against the published Modulos facts. Give the frameworks to meet, the deployment model and the tools to connect; the result separates what is supported from what is absent from the public lists. Nothing in the request is stored.

frameworks.description: Regulations or standards the buyer must meet, for example ["EU AI Act", "ISO 42001", "DORA"].

industry.description: Industry of the buyer, for example "Insurance".

integrations.description: Tools the buyer wants connected, for example ["Jira", "GitHub", "Snowflake"].

name: check_fit
